shortDescription: UPSESSB UP PGT 2022 Final Result with institute details out. Written exam 9–10 May 2026; final result 07 July 2026; institute allotment around 28 July 2026 for 624 posts.
content:
The Uttar Pradesh Secondary Education Services Selection Board (UPSESSB / UPESSC) has released the UP PGT 2022 Final Result along with marks and institute allotment details for Advt. 02/2022 covering 624 posts.

Timeline

  • Exam city: 30 Apr 2026 | Admit card: 06 May 2026
  • Written exam: 09–10 May 2026
  • Answer key: 12 May 2026
  • Result: 02 Jun 2026 | Interview: 15–27 Jun 2026
  • Final result: 07 Jul 2026
  • Institute allotment list: around 28 Jul 2026

Subject-wise final result and cutoff PDFs (Civics, Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Commerce, Hindi, English, Maths, History, Geography and others) are published on the official portal. Candidates should verify allotment details and complete joining formalities only as per board instructions.
